_comment: What a fresh box needs, and what it costs. Sizes are ON DISK as measured
`tier` decides what install.ps1 fetches by default:
standard  the studio as it is normally used
optional  extra models and tools, fetched on request
`min_vram_gb` is the card needed to RUN it, not to download it. The XL
variants are listed so a bigger machine can take them without editing
anything -- install.ps1 hides what will not fit unless -All is passed.
Verified against ACE-Step's own gpu_config.py profiling, 2026-08-20.

models.what: ACE-Step turbo DiT, VAE, Qwen3 text encoder, 5Hz LM 1.7B
models.note: One repo, four components. The studio cannot start ACE-Step without it.

models.what: MiniMax Music 3 - 44.1 kHz stereo, sung lyrics
models.note: The largest single download by far. Skip it with -SkipMiniMax if you only want ACE-Step.
The only 2B variant that can CONTINUE a track (`complete`), pull stems (`extract`) and honour guidance_scale. Slower than turbo: CFG plus 32-100 steps against turbo's 8.

Despite the name this is NOT song continuation - it loads with is_turbo=True and a config identical to plain turbo. 'Continuous' in this codebase refers to non-quantized latents. For continuation use acestep-v15-base.

models.what: Transcription, for pulling lyrics off a track
The lyric/style writer, and the LLM titler
models.note: Runs on CPU when the card is busy; needs no VRAM of its own.

models.what: Apollo MP3 restorer (JusperLee) - the recommended upscaler
models.note: Upstream calls it pytorch_model.bin; apollo.ps1 expects this name.

Lew's checkpoint has no HF repo of its own; this Space redistributes it. Its config (config_apollo_universal.yaml) is committed next to it. Same size as the copy this box was built with (147 MB); byte-identity not verified.

models.what: FlashSR student LDM, vocoder and VAE
models.note: Lands inside the FlashSR clone, where its loader looks. Run -Stage clones first.

models.what: AudioSR upscaler - most accurate, ~10x slower than Apollo

models.note: Needs ~11.5 GB of VRAM to run. Hidden on smaller cards.

models.what: ACE-Step XL base (4B) - XL plus continuation
models.note: Needs ~12 GB. The slowest and largest of the set.
Offloaded to CPU between uses, so this is system RAM rather than VRAM.

clones.what: ACE-Step 1.5 source: inference, the LoRA trainer, preprocess
MSST, which runs the Apollo restorer
AI-music detector used by the forensics scripts

venvs.name: studio
venvs.what: the web server and every pure-python helper

venvs.name: label
venvs.what: beat_this + librosa: bpm/key/meter labelling for the training set (CPU only)

venvs.name: minimax
venvs.what: MiniMax Music 3, and the writer LLM

venvs.name: watermark
venvs.what: DSP: spectrograms, region fill, naturalize, bandwidth checks
